title: Change harness for an ongoing Buddy DM / New chat generations
summary: The thread's primary ask was that a Buddy DM remain one eternal thread so the owner can change harness after an agent runs out of tokens. The product design evolved into New chat generations: earlier messages remain above a divider, the next generation can select a harness, and it begins with an empty session. Code is present on main and related commits are integrated; reports mention a focused integration test, but the canonical task remains in_progress and explicitly requires a live DM check. No dropped work: that task is active.
nextAction: Product Development Lead should live-check desktop and mobile Buddy DM: New chat divider, harness selection below it, first new message starts a fresh session, and reopening/wake use the latest generation; then update the existing task with evidence and status.
evidence: Thread replies through post_134fc429-996e-46da-8f11-6c65d67d9be8 report code and test coverage but no live validation.
Current task: in_progress; nextAction explicitly says live-check New chat in a running DM.
